title: fix(plugin-grid): on a phone, each list card offers its row's actions through one 44 px menu
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbUxcj8HNVLVidnzZ1WNvjyD)_

Fixes #29150

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：手机宽度（768 px 以下，列表画成卡片）时，每张卡片右侧多了一个 44 px 的「⋮」按钮，点开就是这一行在桌面上的全部行操作（编辑、删除、对象声明的行操作），顺序与桌面行的右键菜单一致。点卡片其它位置仍然打开记录。这一行没有任何可用操作时不画按钮。桌面表格不变。
- **为什么改**：#29074 在 375 / 390 px 实测：手机卡片上没有任何行操作入口，长按也只是打开记录。手机用户要编辑或删除一条记录必须先进记录页，只在列表上提供的行操作（`list_item`）根本够不到。
- **风险与回滚**：低。只改 `ObjectGrid.tsx` 卡片渲染里一处：复用桌面行的 `RowActionMenu` 和 `rowActionMenuProps(row)`（同一套权限、谓词、处理函数和确认框），内联预算设为 0，所以所有操作都在一个菜单里。按钮外层用 `-my-2`，实测卡片高度不变（62 px）。不加键、不加 prop、不加导出、不加文案。回滚即回退本 PR。
- **先看**：`ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx` 的 `buildMobileCardRenderer` 末尾 `grid-card-actions` 那一段（只在 `rowOffersAction(row)` 时绘制）；新测试 `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/__tests__/phoneCardRowActions-29150.test.tsx`。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/plugin-grid/src/__tests__/phoneCardRowActions-29150.test.tsx`，预期 4 个用例全部通过；在 `main` 上同一文件 3 个失败。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

Claim: issuecomment-6574754357.

## What changes

Below the 768 px card breakpoint, `ObjectGrid` draws each row as a card (the #28484 layout: title, one subtitle line, one status chip). A card had no action control, so a phone reader had to open each record to edit, delete or run a declared row action, and an action offered only on the list (`list_item`) could not be reached at all.

- **`ObjectGrid`** (plugin-grid), `buildMobileCardRenderer`: each card whose row offers an action ends with the row's own `RowActionMenu`, rendered from `rowActionMenuProps(row)`, the props the desktop row's "⋮" cell and its context menu already read. So it applies the same capability gate, per-record predicates, record-level verdicts, handlers and confirm steps.
- The inline budget is `0` (`maxInlineActions={0}`), the value the desktop row's context menu passes: every action sits in the one menu, in the plan's order (Edit, Delete, primary actions, other actions, legacy actions). On desktop the same set shows in the same order, except that up to one primary action is drawn as a button left of the "⋮".
- The trigger is `RowActionMenu`'s existing one, 44×44 below `sm`. Its wrapper stops the click, so a tap on the control does not open the record, and a tap anywhere else on the card still does. The card's wrapper box takes `-my-2`, so the 44 px target does not make the card taller.
- A card whose row offers nothing (`rowOffersAction(row)` false) draws no control.

The desktop table, the row context menu and the metadata are unchanged. No key, prop, export or locale string is added; the trigger's screen-reader label is the existing `grid.openMenu`.

## Tests

- `phoneCardRowActions-29150.test.tsx` (new), on the real `ObjectGrid` with Edit, Delete and three `list_item` actions (one primary, one gated by `visible`):
  - At 1280 px, the row context menu is read as the reference: Edit, Delete, Promote (primary), Submit for review (draft rows only), Archive. At 390 px, each card's menu lists exactly that row's reference, in the same order, and no inline button is drawn on a card.
  - One trigger per card, inside the card's last box, with the 44 px classes.
  - Choosing Edit from a card's menu calls `onEdit` with that row and does not call `onRowClick`. A tap on another card's title calls `onRowClick` with that row.
  - Control: a grid with no action draws no trigger on any card.
- Red on `main` (0c0d3b68): the first three cases fail ("Unable to find an element by: [data-testid="row-action-trigger"]"), the control passes.
- Ablation (one time, not kept): `maxInlineActions={0}` changed to `maxInlineActions={1}` through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` reds the order case (the primary moves onto the card as an inline button). The restore left `git diff HEAD` empty. A first attempt replaced the anchor with a string that already occurred 41 times; the tool refused it as a no-op, so it did not run.
- Neighbours: `phoneCardRow-28484.test.tsx` and `rowContextMenu-28434.test.tsx` pass unchanged (29/29 with the new file).

## Acceptance notes

Live measurement, Console production build of this branch (`pnpm console:build` at 49c4abf8), served at `/_console` by `pnpm dev:crm -- --seed-admin --fresh`. Chromium with `isMobile` and `hasTouch`, DPR 2, at 390×844 and 375×812; desktop reference at 1280×900. Script and readings: `/mnt/project-files/issue-29150/measure.cjs`, `after/measure.json` (`crm_lead`) and `after/measure-account.json` (`crm_account`).

| Check (`crm_lead`, which declares the `list_item` action Convert Lead) | 390 | 375 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Each card has one row-action control | yes, 44×44, inside the card | yes, 44×44, inside the card |
| Card height with / without the control | 62 / 62 px | 62 / 62 px |
| Card menu equals the desktop row's actions, same order | Edit, Delete, Convert Lead = desktop "⋮" and context menu | same |
| Tap on the control opens the record | no (URL unchanged) | no |
| Tap on the card opens the record | yes | yes |
| Menu fits the viewport; no horizontal page scroll | yes; 390 = 390 | yes; 375 = 375 |
| Title width beside the chip and the control | 200 px on a lead card; 292 px on an account card | 277 px on an account card |

`crm_account` (Edit and Delete only) reads the same: 44×44 control, card 62 px either way, menu equal to the desktop menu, the card tap opens the record. Before this change (`main` a4015ab4, #29074's run record, check L06) a card held no control and a long press opened the record.

Out of scope, reported to the seat: the menu's items are 32 px tall at phone width. That is the shared dropdown item, the same in every phone menu, not this card's control.
